text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"The letter conveys why the applicant wants this specific role rather than just any software engineering job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in applying, with little personal reason for choosing this role or team."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States broad interest in security or backend work, but the motivation remains interchangeable with many similar roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear reason this role fits the applicant's interests or next career step."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong, tailored enthusiasm grounded in the role's exact problem space, such as security automation or internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a memorable and distinctive personal case for this role, making the motivation feel deeply considered and tightly matched to the team's work."}]},{"name":"Platform security leverage mindset","description":"The letter shows understanding that this job scales security through tooling, automation, and secure defaults across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the position mostly as a generic software role and shows little understanding of how the team enables security at scale."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security impact or company scale in broad terms, but does not explain how tooling changes outcomes across an organization."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that foundational systems or automation can benefit many teams beyond one product area."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly discusses ideas such as reducing manual security toil, making the secure path the easy path, or embedding security into the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates a nuanced view of multiplying scarce security judgment through automation, tooling, or variant analysis across a large engineering organization."}]},{"name":"Relevant software engineering scope","description":"The letter indicates the depth of professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only near-minimum relevant experience, with narrow ownership of production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Clearly meets the baseline and shows some production responsibility, but the breadth of ownership remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid relevant experience across multiple production services and across the test, maintain, and launch lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial breadth through repeated ownership of several production systems or clearly above-minimum tenure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive relevant scope, with long-running multi-service ownership and repeated delivery and maintenance of production systems."}]},{"name":"Formal academic preparation","description":"The letter signals the strength of the applicant's formal technical education relative to the role's preferred qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States only a bachelor's-level qualification meeting the minimum requirement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a bachelor's-level qualification and adds some extra signal of technical rigor, but no graduate degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"States doctoral or similarly advanced preparation and clearly connects that training to the deep systems or research-style problems of the role."}]},{"name":"Go backend experience","description":"The letter shows how deeply the applicant has used Go in production backend or infrastructure work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or without evidence of real use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Lists Go as a language used, but gives little sense of depth or backend ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a regular or primary language for production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects Go to concrete backend or infrastructure systems relevant to platform, automation, or security work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows Go as central to designing and operating the kind of auditable, constrained backend systems this role specifically calls for."}]},{"name":"Python experience","description":"The letter shows how strongly the applicant can use Python for services, automation, analysis, or AI-related work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly or only as ad hoc scripting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for tools, automation, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python ownership in production automation, internal services, or analysis tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major engineering language with explicit quality signals or direct use in reliable AI agent systems."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"The letter demonstrates how much practical experience the applicant has building and operating AI-enabled software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without clear evidence of shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes shipping AI or language-model features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Pairs production AI delivery with evaluation, hardening, or reliability work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature applied AI judgment by explaining both production delivery and how model failure modes were managed in role-relevant settings."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"The letter shows experience designing agent-based or autonomously orchestrated systems rather than only ordinary automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic or autonomous workflow design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Describes automation generally but not agent-based or multi-step autonomous systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions building agents or agent-like workflows at a high level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a concrete agent architecture, including the relationship between agents and surrounding services or controls."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong agentic design thinking, with bounded agent behavior and explicit guardrails, logging, permissions, or oversight around those agents."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability handling automation","description":"The letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not describe any experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or response."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to security automation broadly without showing direct ownership of vulnerability-handling work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct experience automating some part of vulnerability report handling or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage functions such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of vulnerability-handling automation with clear evidence that it materially reduced manual workload or improved response flow."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"The letter demonstrates hands-on experience assessing the security of software or systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not describe any security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives only indirect security exposure, such as interest, certifications, or adversarial practice, without actual assessment ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on or structured security assessment experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes substantive assessment methods such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature assessment practice embedded in engineering work, with clear responsibility for findings, remediation, and follow-through."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"The letter shows ability with data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no meaningful evidence of data structures or algorithms ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength but supports it only weakly or not at all."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of using a better data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated or substantial algorithmic problem solving tied to meaningful redesign or performance gains."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking a clear strength, with credible examples of turning previously difficult system behavior into robust, scalable solutions."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"The letter shows whether the applicant thinks like a maintainer who values operational discipline, guardrails, and dependable systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little evidence of thinking about maintenance, inheritance, or operational discipline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions production work but focuses mainly on building features rather than running dependable systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows awareness that testing, maintenance, and dependable operation are important parts of engineering work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes rigor, guardrails, maintainability, or reliable defaults in system design."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a strong maintainer's mindset, treating quiet dependability and operational discipline as core values, especially for security-sensitive systems."}]},{"name":"Supplemental security practice","description":"The letter provides extra evidence of security engagement beyond routine software engineering duties, such as certifications or adversarial practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful extra security signal beyond ordinary software engineering work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Adds a light extra signal, such as a basic certification or casual mention of security exercises."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows sustained extra engagement through regular capture-the-flag participation or a recognized foundational certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong supplemental practice through a demanding hands-on certification, repeated strong competition results, or other serious adversarial work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong supplemental security signals and explains how they sharpen real attacker-minded or defensive judgment."}]},{"name":"Self-directed engineering initiative","description":"The letter shows technical initiative outside assigned job duties through side projects, open-source work, or other self-driven builds.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no meaningful engineering work outside normal job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or casual tinkering with limited scope or ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing initiative through a maintained personal project or occasional upstream contributions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial self-driven work, such as a nontrivial systems project or active maintenance of an open-source project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional initiative through technically ambitious independent builds or stewardship of software used by a real external community."}]},{"name":"Specificity of evidence","description":"The letter supports its claims with concrete examples, actions, and outcomes rather than relying on generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims, adjectives, or self-assessments with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few examples, but they remain generic or thin on action and results."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives several concrete examples of work, though some claims still remain broad."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently supports claims with specific systems, actions, or outcomes that make the experience easy to trust."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is densely evidence-based, using vivid and credible details so the reader can infer capability from examples rather than promises."}]},{"name":"Writing organization","description":"The letter presents its case in a coherent structure with logical flow from motivation to evidence to fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Is hard to follow because the ideas feel disjointed, repetitive, or weakly structured."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Is understandable but choppy or list-like, with limited flow between points."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear overall structure and readable progression, even if somewhat formulaic."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well organized and smooth, with paragraphs that build a coherent and increasingly persuasive case."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally coherent and persuasive, with memorable framing and seamless progression from opening to close."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The letter shows care in spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, typographical, or grammatical errors that noticeably undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors or awkward constructions that distract the reader."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a few minor errors, but they do not materially impede understanding."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mechanically clean, with only rare slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is virtually error-free and shows strong attention to detail in presentation."}]}]}
